text:
Clara Nguyen: Heads-up: support reported confusing error copy across Console and API. Need a single source-of-truth for client messages and badge states.
Bryan Lee: Agreed. propose we add `client_bucket` in error payload + header `X-RW-Client-Bucket`.
Sara Patel: What buckets? keep it small: `retryable`, `quota`, `fallback`.
Clara Nguyen: I like compact names. `retryable` -> show retry hint; `quota` -> surface billing/upgrade CTA; `fallback` -> show degraded badge.
Bryan Lee: Telemetry: emit `client_bucket` tag and a sampled `client_hint` string. Dashboards can show top hint samples.
Sara Patel: Runbook change: alert when `quota` hits >3% for 10m. Console badge colors: `retryable`=orange, `quota`=red, `fallback`=purple.
DevBot: Created task RW-912 for schema + SDK changes.
Clara Nguyen: Action owners: Bryan = API + headers; Sara = console copy + runbook; I'll own telemetry and canary cohort. I'll draft the short RFC today.
